Best meal of our Da Nang trip
Aug 2026 • Family
We visited D c M c Buffet during our family vacation in Da Nang and it turned out to be one of the best dining experiences we had on the entire trip. The spread was massive with so many incredible choices, ranging from fresh local seafood to mouthwatering hot dishes, and everything we tasted was truly delicious. Our kids loved the dessert section, while my partner and I could not stop raving about the grilled items. The service was extremely perfect throughout our meal because the staff were always smiling, clearing empty plates right away, and making sure our glasses stayed full. You can tell they take real pride in their restarant and how they treat guests. If you are traveling around Da Nang with family and looking for great value along with top quality food, you definitely need to eat here.
